data.name: Jankiyaa
data.gender_notes: Jankiyaa is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Jankiyaa is derived from the Sanskrit language and means 'God's Grace'. This name is often given to a boy in the Hindu tradition to signify the presence of the divine in his life. The name Jankiyaa carries the meaning “God's Grace” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Jankiyaa usually hope their child will grow to embody god's grace and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Jankiyaa belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God's Grace.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jankiyaa total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

It also highlights the tradition of naming practices in Hindu culture, where names hold Deep spiritual and philosophical meanings that shape the identity and values of the individual.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Jankiyaa is imbued with spiritual significance as it represents the constant presence of God's Grace in one's life. The name serves as a reminder to the individual to be humble, thankful and mindful of the blessings bestowed upon them by the divine. It encourages the individual to live a righteous and devotional life, seeking to align oneself with the will of God and striving to be a vessel of His Love and Blessings to the world.
